deadline.value: Complete packets by February 15 are needed for teaching assistantship consideration for the academic year.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: February 15. If you wish to receive a Teaching Assistantship for the academic year, your complete application packet must be received by February 15.

gre_subject.value: The department's pages do not mention a GRE subject test.

supervisor.value: Most students are admitted with a research advisor already chosen; otherwise one must be found by the end of the first year.
supervisor.quote: Students will usually be admitted into the program with a Research Advisor already identified.

funding.value: The pages mention teaching assistantships but do not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: The department's pages do not state whether a master's is needed.

toefl_min.value: The CS department sets its own TOEFL iBT minimum of 92 (internet-based), overriding the Graduate School rule.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL scores of at least 580 (paper-based exam), at least 237 (computer-based exam) or at least 92 (internet-based exam)

ielts_min.value: The CS department requires IELTS 7.0, above the Graduate School's 6.5.

notes: The department says these minimums may be waived at the Graduate Admissions Committee's discretion. Teaching assistantships are mentioned for applicants who meet the 15 February deadline.
